articles.summary: ARLINGTON, Va. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--May 5, 2026-- Graham Holdings Company (NYSE: GHC) today declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.88 per share, payable on August 6, 2026, to shareholders of record on July 16, 2026. View source version on businesswire.com:
articles.title: Graham Holdings Company Declares Regular Quarterly Dividend
